# COLONY NOTICE BOARD
## WATER RATIONING Reclamation output is below quota this cycle. Showers are limited to four minutes. Report leaking fittings to maintenance.
## ATMOSPHERE PROCESSOR The processor will run on reduced cycles during routine servicing. Residents may notice a metallic smell near vents. This is normal.
## LOST AND FOUND One pair of work boots, size 11, left in the mess hall. Claim at the administration desk.
## CURFEW REMINDER Exterior hatches lock at 2200 colony time. Anyone outside after curfew must check in with the Marshal's Office.
